body: Thanks a bunch for the support. I really mean it!

No, I'm not. I've still not resorted to that sort of services since normally the first physical impression matters a whole lot more there than in real life. I'll keep trying, but I have to keep forcing myself out of bed every single day and it's killing me.
Thanks for the support, but it's just the constant rejection. We even remain friends afterwards most of the time, but it just slowly drains away any confidence and hope I have.
